plan.summary: Add existing mode-scoped MCP tools alongside permitted native tools in Claude Code and Codex through a minimal runtime bridge, concise operation-specific guidance and compatible checkpoint reconciliation. Deliver six stories with offline checks and a separate authentic four-scenario evidence obligation; broader #264 workflow adoption remains deferred.

stories.title: Connect each agent launch to authorized factory tools

user_story.want: each eligible actual agent launch connected to the existing authorized factory tools
user_story.benefit: agents can use supported operations while concurrent attempts remain isolated and broader workflow changes stay deferred
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-1, Data Model, API / Interface Changes, Business Rules and lifecycle edge cases.
This is the minimum shared runtime prerequisite for both host integrations; existing services exist but ordinary execution does not yet connect them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Eligible enabled actual launches bind existing trusted MCP services and a matching tool-enabled broker; disabled/absent registration preserves prior behavior, and Research/Spike availability does not require managed-story conversion.

Runtime authority is startup-owned; each actual cold/resumed/fallback launch receives isolated scope and resources, with cancellation/exit/replacement cleanup that does not revoke concurrent attempts.
Neutral registration carries validated immutable paths/attempt and a copied exact installed permitted-tool catalog; invalid/stale/mismatched registration is refused before host launch.

tasks.description: Deliver the validated immutable neutral registration and installed-catalog projection described by feature-spec Data Model and AC-003, with defensive copies and rejection before host launch.
Connect startup-owned authority and per-actual-launch trusted services/broker for feature-spec US-1, including unmanaged Research/Spike, policy-disabled behavior, replacement and cleanup.
Write and execute focused fake-boundary tests for registration validation, catalog copying, enabled/disabled behavior and attempt ownership from feature-spec AC-001–AC-003; retain actual results.

architecture.summary: Reuse current turn/submission services with one runtime owner and immutable provider handoffs; keep preparation independent of managed-submission eligibility.

components.name: internal/daemon and internal/cli
components.responsibility: Compose one runtime-owned turn.AttemptAuthority against the existing migrated store and close only on owned shutdown.

components.responsibility: Prepare each actual launch through existing result binding, installed family grants, permission digest, attempt guard and dispatcher.

interfaces.name: MCPLaunchSpec
interfaces.input: Trusted executable/descriptor/attempt and installed permitted tools
interfaces.output: Validated immutable launch registration or error

interfaces.name: Actual-launch preparation
interfaces.input: Runtime authority, current run/mode/scope, optional managed submission session and cancellation context
interfaces.output: Bound guarded services, matching broker, registration and scoped cleanup

constraints: Bind at the runSubmissionBound actual-launch seam for cold/resumed/fallback launches; nil managed sessions must not suppress Research/Spike preparation or cause invented managed identities.
Project tools from the installed dispatcher/profile; preserve current target/creation grants and handler installation rules. Providers do not receive services, store access or authority decisions.
Enabled preparation failure stops the launch with diagnostics; absent/disabled registration keeps prior behavior and allocates no usable authority.
Revoke only the ending attempt; cancel and join broker workers, clean partial setup and propagate cleanup failures. Preserve store ownership and single connection; no transaction across external I/O.
Use config.Paths for LF_HOME paths, existing narrow submission-directory admission and minimal environments; no capability/descriptor content or forge secrets in prompts/logs.

Evidence inventory AC-001: Proof method: Source review and offline production-preparation tests using real local store/broker seams and fake host runner. Source availability: Existing services available; new production bridge coverage not written. Version/context bounds: Current implemented source snapshot; does not establish actual host use. Missing prerequisite / disposition: Implement bridge and retain executed evidence, including unmanaged modes and disabled policy. Production-seam coverage is completed in US-005.

Evidence inventory AC-002: Proof method: Offline concurrency, cancellation and cold/resume/fallback tests across the production preparation seam. Source availability: Existing authority tests available; integrated lifecycle coverage not written. Version/context bounds: Current implemented source snapshot; does not establish actual host lifecycle compatibility. Missing prerequisite / disposition: Implement startup owner and per-launch cleanup; retain executed evidence. Production-seam coverage is completed in US-005.

Evidence inventory AC-003: Proof method: Value validation, defensive-copy, catalog-equality and rejected-launch tests. Source availability: Existing launch-value validation available; permitted catalog handoff absent. Version/context bounds: Current implemented source snapshot; provider acceptance additionally requires authentic captures. Missing prerequisite / disposition: Extend immutable handoff and retain executed rejection/copy assertions.

decisions.decision: Initialize authority once per runtime, never per turn.
decisions.reason: StartMCPInstance replaces previous runtime identity and could invalidate concurrent work.

decisions.decision: Reuse existing services and actual-launch binding without new schema or scheduler adoption.
decisions.reason: Scope is usable host wiring; broad #264 orchestration remains deferred.

stories.title: Make factory tools available in Claude Code

user_story.want: attempt-local factory tools alongside my permitted native tools
user_story.benefit: I can perform supported factory operations without losing native capabilities or weakening mode restrictions
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-2, Claude launch interface, AC-004 and configuration edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: Claude receives a private per-attempt generated MCP config for the adapter plus retained strict MCP isolation and exact MCP tool authorization, preserving existing native tool ceilings, including Validate.

tasks.description: Deliver Claude's private per-attempt configuration and exact authorization from feature-spec US-2, preserving native ceilings, strict isolation and cleanup for every launch outcome.
Write and execute decoded configuration/argv, permission, lifetime, native-tool preservation and cold/resume/error/cancellation tests with fake executables; retain actual evidence for AC-004.

architecture.summary: Provider-owned JSON/file lifecycle consumes the neutral registration without widening the native tool grammar.

components.name: internal/harness
components.responsibility: Serialize private per-attempt JSON and add fixed-server MCP authorization at argv assembly while retaining existing surface(req) native ceiling.

interfaces.name: Claude launch registration
interfaces.input: Validated neutral registration and existing native tool surface
interfaces.output: Private MCP config, --mcp-config, retained --strict-mcp-config and explicit exact MCP permission names

constraints: Preserve explicit --tools and existing native authorization; introduce a separately validated fixed-server MCP registration surface rather than widening user-config grammar.

Exclude ambient .mcp.json servers and reject collisions that could replace authorized litefactory registration. Preserve cold/resume/fallback behavior and remove files on success, launch error and cancellation.
Use structured JSON, fixed executable/serve arguments and minimal environment; preserve quoted/non-ASCII/syntax-containing values without shell interpolation.

Evidence inventory AC-004: Proof method: Structured config/argv/file-permission/cleanup tests and source review; actual interpretation cross-referenced to AC-009/AC-010. Source availability: Runner source exists; generated registration and authentic observations unavailable. Version/context bounds: Tested source plus actual Claude capture version, not historical version command alone. Missing prerequisite / disposition: Implement runner path; external capture remains required for runtime claims.

decisions.decision: Retain native tool ceilings and strict MCP isolation while adding exact MCP authorization separately.
decisions.reason: Existing native config intentionally rejects MCP strings; replacing the ceiling would weaken Validate and isolation.

user_story.want: attempt-local factory tools alongside my permitted native tools
user_story.benefit: I can perform supported factory operations within the existing sandbox and mode restrictions
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-3, Codex launch interface, AC-005 and configuration edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.text: Codex receives correctly encoded command/args/minimal-env/exact-enabled-tools MCP configuration, preserving existing sandbox/config isolation and Validate shell/multi-agent restrictions.

tasks.description: Deliver structured per-attempt Codex server overrides from feature-spec US-3, preserving native tools, effective sandbox, user-config isolation, delivery strictness and Validate restrictions.
Write and execute decoded override tests for quoted/backslash/newline values, exact catalogs, collisions and enabled/disabled cold/resume/fallback paths with fake providers; retain AC-005 evidence.

architecture.summary: Provider-owned config serialization consumes neutral immutable registration alongside existing args assembly.

components.responsibility: Encode mcp_servers command/args/env/enabled_tools and preserve configuration isolation, resume argument placement and Validate feature disabling.

interfaces.input: Validated neutral registration, current sandbox and isolated provider settings
interfaces.output: Structured per-attempt mcp_servers overrides with exact enabled_tools

constraints: Place overrides before resume subcommand and stdin marker as existing argument parsing requires; use no shell wrapper.
Retain features.shell_tool=false, features.multi_agent=false and read-only Validate; do not widen broker root admission.
Respect existing ignore-user-config/delivery strictness and refuse colliding server settings that could replace the trusted adapter. No persistent user config edits.

Evidence inventory AC-005: Proof method: Structured config/encoding/isolation tests and source review; actual interpretation cross-referenced to AC-009/AC-010. Source availability: Runner source exists; registration and authentic observations unavailable. Version/context bounds: Tested source plus actual Codex capture version; unsupported nested invocation excluded. decisions.decision: Encode structured command, args, minimal env and exact enabled_tools from the neutral registration.

stories.title: Give agents concise guidance for supported factory operations

user_story.want: short operation-specific guidance with valid payload context
user_story.benefit: I can correct input, submit it and inspect the matching receipt without confusing result types or duplicating effects
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-4, prompt interface, guidance Business Rules and research run 0003 wording.

acceptance_criteria.text: Guidance is conditional on live installed operations, uses the agreed compact cards and valid supplied payload contracts, separates application results from checkpoints, teaches diagnostics/receipt/retry handling, and preserves final responses/artifacts and existing Plan/publication permissions; measured guidance sizes and available token measurements or explicit unavailability are recorded.

tasks.description: Deliver dynamic shared guidance, conditional operation cards and a single valid relevant payload contract per feature-spec US-4 and research run 0003, preserving final output and permission semantics.

Write and execute per-mode/provider render, installed-card eligibility and parseable payload-shape tests; record word/byte counts and actual provider token measurements or explicit unavailability, explaining editorial target overruns.

architecture.summary: Use one small shared dynamic renderer after live installed services and trusted payload context are known.

components.name: internal/harness shared prompt path and internal/turn binding seam
components.responsibility: Render equivalent provider-neutral instructions from the installed catalog plus current trusted payload/baseline context.

interfaces.name: Conditional MCP guidance
interfaces.input: Live registration/catalog and one relevant application/checkpoint payload contract including trusted update baseline where required
interfaces.output: Shared usage guidance, applicable operation cards and relevant mode sentence; absent registration yields no MCP instructions

constraints: Use communication_preflight(P) -> communication_submit(P) -> communication_receipt({request_id:ID}) for application results; use feedback_preflight({kind:checkpoint,input:C}) -> evidence_submit(C) -> receipts_get({request_id:ID}) for checkpoints only where installed.

Include conditional issue lookup, authorized comment, advisory activity, separately granted creation and mode notes from research run 0003; avoid repeating schemas and unsupported operations. Issue list/get provide repository summaries, not full bodies/comments.
Keep supplied typed Plan helper publication path; communication tools do not publish completed Plans. Supply trusted update revision/baseline and no factory identities or unsupported fields.

Explain preflight diagnostics/correction, receipt lookup before exit, separate receipt states, pending/uncertain outcomes and known-request recovery before retry/alternate submission. Do not mutate input solely to force retries.
Validate uses supplied snapshots and retained evidence only: no shell, edits or fresh checks; keep required final findings. Ordinary runs need not use MCP.

Editorial targets: roughly 150–200 shared words and 300–450 combined words excluding one payload contract. Record actual sizes and available provider-rendered token measurements including schemas/examples or explicit unavailability; counts alone do not prove billed tokens or savings.
Dynamic prompt delivery only; no protected instruction-tree changes. If those prove necessary, replan independently owned provider stories before adding scope.

Evidence inventory AC-006: Proof method: Conditional prompt render/schema-shape tests, documented word/byte sizes and available actual provider token measurements. Source availability: Existing payload contracts and proposed wording available; new renders/telemetry not supplied. Version/context bounds: Per-mode/provider installed catalogs on implementation revision; unavailable billing/token detail explicitly bounded. Missing prerequisite / disposition: Implement guidance, retain size checks and genuine measurement availability.

decisions.decision: Derive guidance and provider permissions from the same installed catalog.
decisions.reason: Agents must not see instructions for uninstalled operations.

decisions.decision: Supply a single relevant payload contract dynamically.
decisions.reason: Current generic schemas need concrete help without repetitive mode-irrelevant boilerplate.

stories.title: Keep live checkpoints and launch recovery compatible with existing completion

user_story.want: live checkpoint use and recovery to preserve existing completion behavior with executed automated evidence
user_story.benefit: repeated output cannot duplicate effects and failures or concurrent launches cannot leak authority
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-5, Completion compatibility interface, lifecycle/recovery edge cases, AC-007 and AC-008.
Provider-specific unit checks stay in their stories; this story owns durable reconciliation and cross-host production-seam coverage.

acceptance_criteria.text: Live Validate checkpoint receipts are reconciled with required terminal findings so repeat output/recovery cannot apply duplicate contributions/effects; missing/conflicting findings remain explicit failures or unverified states under the existing completion contract.

Automated checks cover enabled/disabled/absent setup, malformed/quoted values, catalog parity, native-tool preservation, server collision/isolation, concurrent attempts, cancellation, cleanup, resume/fallback and completion reconciliation; implementation passes make check with actual retained output and no live agent acquisition in checks.

tasks.description: Deliver durable live-plus-terminal checkpoint reconciliation from feature-spec completion rules, matching bound identity and canonical content, preserving full terminal coverage and explicit conflicts.

Write and execute real-local-store/broker tests with fake hosts across the production preparation seam for feature-spec AC-001/AC-002 evidence and this story's AC-007/AC-008; include duplicate/lost-reply/conflict, isolation, unmanaged-mode and replacement cases.

Complete the AC-008 coverage matrix using preceding scoped checks, fix failures within approved scope, execute make check on the final implementation snapshot and retain actual output and snapshot attribution.

user_story.benefit: delivery claims are supported by observed tool use, correction and enforcement rather than configuration alone
notes: Traces to feature-spec US-6, Verification record data model, external-evidence rules and AC-009–AC-011.

The evidence handoff can be prepared before captures arrive, but unavailable proof remains an unsatisfied acceptance obligation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Authentic ordinary top-level Claude and Codex working-mode runs on the implemented revision each show permitted MCP discovery, a correctable preflight diagnostic followed by repaired input in that attempt, submission and matching durable decision receipt observed before exit, plus use of a permitted native tool alongside MCP.

Authentic Validate runs on both hosts show effective narrow native/MCP inventories, allowed live checkpoint/receipt use before exit, and observable refusal/unavailability of shell and delegation escape paths; merely refraining from shell or asserting configuration is insufficient, and retained evidence is used without edits/fresh execution.

Reviewed sanitized evidence records host/version, implementation revision, environment/configuration, protocol/transport, exact observed calls, source locators, stable attempt/request correlation, ordered decision/exit events and separate receipt dimensions, with provenance, SHA256 and record/byte counts; offline replay and documentation state only supported observations and preserve missing obligations.
